curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate registration from title and the age and new-resident rules, then walk through what registering requires, dealer registration and the two insurance cards.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for registration versus title, the registering checklist, dealer registration and insurance cards; a contrast card on road permission versus ownership proof.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what registration and title each do and what to bring to register.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the ownership papers for each kind of purchase, checking a title for liens and defects, the odometer and damage statements by model year, and salvage examinations.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per paperwork rule; contrast cards on dealer versus private papers and the nine versus ten model-year disclosure cutoffs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a purchase type or title problem and asking what is needed or what happens.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who collects sales tax and the private-sale tax form, registration length, fees and refunds, and why sellers remove plates and stickers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for sales tax, fees and refunds, and plate removal; a contrast card on dealer versus private sales tax.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sales tax paths and plate refunds.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the renewal cycle and reminders, weekend and holiday expiries, then the mail, online and in-person renewal paths side by side.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each renewal rule and path; a contrast card comparing mail, online and office renewal.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an owner's situation and asking which renewal path fits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain continuous liability coverage, the minimum amounts, what to do before coverage lapses, the motorcycle exception, and penalties for uninsured driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for coverage duty, minimums, lapses and penalties; contrast cards on the death versus injury minimums and the motorcycle plate exception.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the coverage minimums and asks what follows a lapse.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover inspection deadlines for each kind of buyer, exemptions, re-inspection and stations, results, emissions rules and waivers, diesel checks, and how to complain about dealers and shops.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each inspection rule and the complaint path; a contrast card on the three inspection clocks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on inspection deadlines and emissions rules.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec03-m01..sec03-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
